## Gymshark Vital Seamless 2.0 – honest review

![Bot Verification](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5KRBG8cYUtkZU3wMfZwr8ydyLjprznRKgGPj4nO3U8HGtFQEGHZBB3Ip0rz-TSItWnQI-c0IbC7DkQerCGVJsXuUkB4vV8tZSVPx3A0wiathPvNpsWChK3YY0wfznlWWBiiAfONg7Wwu3hwyDJDrnMFWiPJHHGRMHCp_HXwSSkZ68PXg80jqbrcTCyg6aQ2c?purpose=fullsize)

**Vital Regular Leggings**

# 4.1/5

Gymshark customer rating · 5,164 reviews

**\$54**

Current listed price

[Shop at Gymshark](https://www.gymshark.com/products/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0-leggings-leggings-purple-aw26?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What people love

- **Flattering fit\:** Contouring details enhance your glutes and thighs.
- **Comfort\:** Stretchy nylon fabric with seamless construction.
- **Waistband\:** High-rise waistband generally stays in place.
- **Compression\:** Gives a snug, supportive feeling.
- **Versatility\:** Good for lifting, HIIT and everyday wear.

[row.gymshark.com](https://row.gymshark.com/products/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0-leggings-espresso-marl-aw24?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[row.gymshark.com](https://row.gymshark.com/products/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0-leggings-evening-blue-marl-ss23?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.verywellfit.com](https://www.verywellfit.com/best-gymshark-leggings-7499131?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Common complaints

- **See-through concerns\:** Some customers report transparency during squats, especially in lighter colors.
- **Sizing\:** Can feel quite tight; some recommend sizing up.
- **Durability\:** A minority report seam splitting or fabric thinning.
- **Waistband\:** Can feel restrictive when sitting.

[row.gymshark.com](https://row.gymshark.com/products/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0-leggings-espresso-marl-aw24?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.outdoorgearlab.com](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/reviews/clothing-womens/leggings/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0?sort_field=score&specs=n&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[se.gymshark.com](https://se.gymshark.com/products/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0-leggings-leggings-pink-aw26?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Are they squat-proof?

This is the biggest controversy.

An independent October 2026 review found that the leggings became sheer under full stretch and failed its squat test. Other testers have reported good opacity.

My recommendation\:

- Black and darker marl colors are safer bets.
- Be more cautious with pale colors.
- Always do a squat test in natural lighting before removing the tags.

[www.outdoorgearlab.com](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/reviews/clothing-womens/leggings/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0?sort_field=score&specs=n&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shape.com](https://www.shape.com/best-gymshark-leggings-7554163?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[row.gymshark.com](https://row.gymshark.com/products/gymshark-vital-seamless-2-0-leggings-espresso-marl-aw24?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My verdict

(Worth considering)

I'd recommend them if you want a flattering, compressive gym legging that stays in place. However, I wouldn't buy them expecting buttery-soft fabric or guaranteed squat-proof coverage.

### One question before I recommend them\:

What matters most to you?

- Glute enhancement / flattering shape
- Squat-proof for heavy leg days
- Softness and comfort
- Tummy control
- A combination of everything

I can also compare them with Gymshark Adapt, Elevate and other popular seamless leggings.
